    Normalization of Boca words #

    The density field of MeasurementAlgebraStructure is stated for arbitrary lists of factor letters, whereas the reduced-product moment theorems are stated for lists whose adjacent factor indices differ. This file supplies the missing algebraic bridge: adjacent letters from the same factor are multiplied inside that factor.

    The construction is purely syntactic. Its evaluation theorem uses only multiplicativity of each factor StarAlgHom; it introduces no analytic input and no free-product permanence hypothesis.

    ReducedBocaWord X m → ReducedBocaWord X m

    Prepend one factor letter to a reduced tail, multiplying it into the first tail letter when both letters come from the same factor.

        source
        @[simp]
        theorem ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.CEP.Faithful.ReducedBocaWord.normalize_cons {X : Type} [DecidableEq X] {m : ℕ} (x : X) (a : Fin m → ℂ) (word : CEP.BocaReducedWord X m) :
        normalize ((x, a) :: word) = normalizeCons x a (normalize word)

        Normalization of a nonempty word is normalization of its tail followed by the factor-aware prepend operation.

        source
        theorem ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.CEP.Faithful.ReducedBocaWord.evalWord_normalizeCons {X : Type} [DecidableEq X] {m : ℕ} {B : Type u} [CStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder B] [StarOrderedRing B] (iota : X → (Fin m → ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] B) (x : X) (a : Fin m → ℂ) (tail : ReducedBocaWord X m) :
        CEP.evalWord iota (normalizeCons x a tail).word = (iota x) a * CEP.evalWord iota tail.word

        normalizeCons preserves evaluation: the only nontrivial branch is the same-factor branch, where map_mul and associativity merge the two letters.
